title: The Cellar of the Bell House
author: Lena Montrose
blurb: Wren Underhill, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
